svg.title: Microsoft Graph: The Data Connector
svg.desc: Microsoft 365 Copilot calls the Microsoft Graph API, which connects to five Microsoft 365 data sources: Outlook (mail and calendar), Microsoft Teams (chat and collaboration), SharePoint (files and intranet), OneDrive (files and storage), and the Microsoft 365 apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and others).
svg.text: Copilot reaches your organisation's Microsoft 365 data through the Graph API.
